events.description: Every business has a story shaped by big ideas, tough decisions, unexpected challenges, and lessons learned along the way. Join AMA Southwest Michigan for a candid panel discussion with local business leaders as they share how they got started, the risks they took, the obstacles they faced, and the strategies that helped them grow. The conversation will explore entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, and what it takes to build and sustain a business in today’s market. events.title: Vicksburg/Schoolcraft Business Community Townhall
events.description: Vicksburg/Schoolcraft Business Community Townhall 108 S Main St Vicksburg, MI Tuesday, September 29 • 8:30 AM – 10 AM Overview Let’s come together for a lively community discussion on boosting local businesses and creating a thriving environment for all! Join the Southwest Michigan First Chamber for the upcoming Vicksburg/Schoolcraft Business Community Townhall! This is your chance to connect with local city and community leaders, share your insights, and explore opportunities that shape the future of the Vicksburg/Schoolcraft area. Together, let’s spark collaboration and work toward meaningful progress for our community. Topics may include: Economic and community development updates Upcoming construction projects and infrastructure improvements Events and initiatives driving foot traffic Safety, accessibility, and parking updates Open Q&A with city and community leaders Bring your ideas, your challenges, and your neighbors—we’ll supply the refreshments and an open, welcoming platform for discussion. We look forward to seeing you there! About the Southwest Michigan First Chamber The Southwest Michigan First Chamber is dedicated to fostering the connection, development, collaboration, and growth of the small business community and its leaders throughout greater Kalamazoo County. The Chamber supports the mission of Southwest Michigan First not only in its support of the creation of well-paying jobs, but also through the strengthening of our existing small business community. A strong small business presence is a proven key attractor for new businesses and a reason why families, existing companies, and their employees want to stay here.

events.description: ¡QUEREMOS ESCUCHARTE! ALMUERZO CON EMPRENDEDORES Y DUEÑOS DE NEGOCIOS DE KALAMAZOO El programa Camino al Éxito de El Concilio invita a los emprendedores y propietarios de negocios de nuestra comunidad a compartir un almuerzo y participar en un espacio de diálogo abierto. Queremos escuchar sus experiencias, conocer sus necesidades, entender los desafíos que enfrentan y descubrir cómo podemos continuar apoyándolos para fortalecer y hacer crecer sus negocios. ¡Tu voz es importante! Este encuentro es una oportunidad para compartir ideas, expresar inquietudes y contribuir a la creación de nuevas oportunidades para nuestra comunidad empresarial. Fecha: Sábado 31 de octubre de 2026 Hora: 12:00 p.m. a 1:30 p.m. Lugar: El Concilio 2501 Millcork St, Kalamazoo, MI 49001 INSCRIPCIÓN OBLIGATORIA El almuerzo es gratuito, pero es indispensable registrarse previamente para participar. Regístrate aquí: https://forms.gle/gKQeBkn7ctw346FLA ¡Queremos conocer tu historia, escuchar tus ideas y trabajar juntos por el éxito de nuestros negocios! Organiza: Programa Camino al Éxito de El Concilio WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU! LUNCH WITH ENTREPRENEURS AND BUSINESS OWNERS OF THE KALAMAZOO COMMUNITY The El Concilio’s Path to Success program invites entrepreneurs and business owners from our community to share a lunch and participate in an open dialogue. We want to hear your experiences, understand your needs, identify the challenges you face, and discover how we can continue to support you in strengthening and growing your businesses. Your voice matters! This meeting is an opportunity to share ideas, express concerns, and contribute to creating new opportunities for our business community. Date: Saturday, October 31, 2026 Time: 12:00 p.m. to 1:30 p.m. Location: El Concilio 2501 Millcork St, Kalamazoo, MI 49001 Mandatory Registration Lunch is free, but registration is required to participate. Register here: https://forms.gle/gKQeBkn7ctw346FLA We want to hear your story, listen to your ideas, and work together for the success of our businesses! events.description: Pitch your project, idea, or business for funding and resources. Five finalists are selected to compete for $10,000 in equity-free capital! Every other month, five (5) businesses will pitch live to three (3) judges for $10,000 in equity-free capital, partnership, customers, and free resources to start or grow their idea. Attendees can engage and vote for their favorite pitch. The People’s Favorite walks away with $1,000. Register to RSVP, bring a friend, vote, and support your local entrepreneurs! 2026 dates are as follows: Jan. 16, March 13, May 15, Sept. 21 and Nov. 13 6 – 8 p.m. Please note: All events except Sept. 21 take place at StartUp Zoo.
